# Resolute Group (Resolute Corp Bharat Private Limited)

> Diversified investment and venture-building group based in Ahmedabad, India, with ventures in real estate, fashion and sports. Tagline: Progress is vitality.

## Ventures
- [ShareSquare](https://www.resolutecorp.in/portfolio/sharesquare): fractional real estate investment platform for premium UAE properties ([website](https://sharesquare.ae/)).
- [Hair Drama Co.](https://www.resolutecorp.in/portfolio/hair-drama-co): handmade hair fashion accessories, established 2015 ([website](https://www.hairdramacompany.com/)).
- [Delhi Toofans](https://www.resolutecorp.in/portfolio/delhi-toofans): Prime Volleyball League franchise, owned by Resolute Sports; award winners in every season since its 2024 debut ([website](https://delhitoofans.com/)).
- [Hyderabad Toofans](https://www.resolutecorp.in/portfolio/hyderabad-toofans): Hockey India League franchise, owned by Resolute Sports ([website](https://hyderabadtoofans.net/)).

## Leadership
- Alok Sanghi, Managing Director, Resolute Group.
- Priyanka Sanghi, Founder, Hair Drama Co.; leads the Group's lifestyle portfolio.
